notes.title: Fist of Physics 1.0.3 now LIVE!
notes.content:
The mysterious virus causing ‘bots to go haywire has spread to a nearby military base! Reports are coming in of a rogue Mobile Cover Unit called Wall-4 terrorizing the city and swarms of deadly drones have been spotted patrolling the skies. 


1.0.3 Fist of Physics Update Includes:
[list]
[*]Test your might against new foes: Wall-4 and Cyclops Drones
[*] Fight Night! You can now fight in a nighttime version of the city square
[*] UI polish
[/endlist]

notes.title: Details on the Fist of Physics 1.02 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Update 1.02 of Fist of Physics comes with a raft of new adjustments, based on the excellent feedback you’ve given us. Keep those comments coming!
[list]
[*] Oculus support! (not final; requires room scale and touch controllers)
[*] Robot fists match ghost hand animation
[*] Added a custom keyboard
[*] Robots will attack wildly after losing their head
[*] Robots will try to stay within the chaperone bounds
[*] Various small bug fixes 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 : Anti-flail Improvement and UI Touch-ups
notes.content:
In today's patch we fixed some critical bugs and made some UI and sound touch-ups to improve the gameplay. As always please share with us your most candid feedback and we will continuously improve FOP !

- fixed a startup UI bug that prevents players from entering the game in some rare cases
- improved flail prevention logic to allow fast punch
- added more sound effects
- improved power mode UI
- improved damage calculation during grab and throw
- optimized performance for building demolishing
